report.summary: Patient P-D005 (age 34, commercial employer HMO, home tract 17031241400 in Cook County, IL) was seen today (visit V-D005) with a food-access need. The most recent CMS AHC screener (2026-10-22) answered food_worry and food_ran_out as "never_true," and the tract is not flagged as low-income or low-income/low-access (USDA LILA = 0.0), so current food insecurity is not indicated by screening or neighborhood data. Nonetheless, the following community food resources were identified from the directory; none require the patient's commercial insurance.
